### [CLIMutableAttribute](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-climutableattribute.html)

CLIMutableAttribute

 with a default constructor with property getters and setters.

### [ComparisonConditionalOnAttribute](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-comparisonconditionalonattribute.html)

ComparisonConditionalOnAttribute 
This attribute is used to indicate a generic container type satisfies the F# 'comparison' 
 constraint only if a generic argument also satisfies this constraint. 
For example, adding 
 this attribute to parameter 'T on a type definition C<'T> means that a type C<X> only supports 
 comparison if the type X also supports comparison and all other conditions for C<X> to support 
 comparison are also met. The type C<'T> can still be used with other type arguments, but a type such 
 as C<(int -> int)> will not support comparison because the type (int -> int) is an F# function type 
 and does not support comparison.

 This attribute will be ignored if it is used on the generic parameters of functions or methods.
  
ComparisonConditionalOnAttribute.``.ctor`` 
``.ctor``

### [ComparisonConditionalOnAttribute.``.ctor``](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-comparisonconditionalonattribute.html#``.ctor``)

### [EqualityConditionalOnAttribute](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-equalityconditionalonattribute.html)

EqualityConditionalOnAttribute 
This attribute is used to indicate a generic container type satisfies the F# 'equality' 
 constraint only if a generic argument also satisfies this constraint. 
 For example, adding 
 this attribute to parameter 'T on a type definition C<'T> means that a type C<X> only supports 
 equality if the type X also supports equality and all other conditions for C<X> to support 
 equality are also met. The type C<'T> can still be used with other type arguments, but a type such 
 as C<(int -> int)> will not support equality because the type (int -> int) is an F# function type 
 and does not support equality.
 
 This attribute will be ignored if it is used on the generic parameters of functions or methods.
  
EqualityConditionalOnAttribute.``.ctor`` 
``.ctor``

### [InlineIfLambdaAttribute](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-inlineiflambdaattribute.html)

InlineIfLambdaAttribute 
Adding this attribute to a parameter of function type indicates that, if the overall function or method is inlined and the parameter is
 determined to be a known lambda, then this function should be statically inlined throughout the body of the function of method. 
If the function parameter is called multiple times in the implementation of the function or method this attribute may cause code explosion and slow compilation times. 
InlineIfLambdaAttribute.``.ctor`` 
``.ctor``

### [NoComparisonAttribute](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-nocomparisonattribute.html)

NoComparisonAttribute 
Adding this attribute to a type indicates it is a type where comparison is an abnormal operation.
 This means that the type does not satisfy the F# 'comparison' constraint. Within the bounds of the 
 F# type system, this helps ensure that the F# generic comparison function is not instantiated directly
 at this type. The attribute and checking does not constrain the use of comparison with base or child 
 types of this type.
  
NoComparisonAttribute.``.ctor`` 
``.ctor``

### [NoComparisonAttribute.``.ctor``](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-nocomparisonattribute.html#``.ctor``)

NoComparisonAttribute.``.ctor`` 
``.ctor`` 
Creates an instance of the attribute

### [NoDynamicInvocationAttribute](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-nodynamicinvocationattribute.html)

NoDynamicInvocationAttribute 
This attribute is used to tag values that may not be dynamically invoked at runtime. This is
 typically added to inlined functions whose implementations include unverifiable code. It
 causes the method body emitted for the inlined function to raise an exception if 
 dynamically invoked, rather than including the unverifiable code in the generated
 assembly. 
NoDynamicInvocationAttribute.``.ctor`` 
``.ctor``

### [Option<'T>](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-fsharpoption-1.html)

Option<'T> 
The type of optional values. When used from other CLI languages the
 empty option is the <code>null</code> value.  
Use the constructors <code>Some</code> and <code>None</code> to create values of this type.
 Use the values in the <code>Option</code> module to manipulate values of this type,
 or pattern match against the values directly.

 <code>None</code> values will appear as the value <code>null</code> to other CLI languages.
 Instance methods on this type will appear as static methods to other CLI languages
 due to the use of <code>null</code> as a value representation. 
Option<'T>.Value 
Value 
Option<'T>.IsSome 
IsSome 
Option<'T>.IsNone 
IsNone 
Option<'T>.Some 
Some 
Option<'T>.op_Implicit 
op_Implicit 
Option<'T>.None 
None 
Option<'T>.None 
None 
Option<'T>.Some 
Some

Option<'T>.Value 
Value 
Get the value of a 'Some' option. A NullReferenceException is raised if the option is 'None'.

Option<'T>.op_Implicit 
op_Implicit 
Implicitly converts a value into an optional that is a 'Some' value. 
The F# compiler ignored this method when determining possible type-directed conversions. Instead, use <code>Some</code> or <code>None</code> explicitly.

### [StructuredFormatDisplayAttribute](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-structuredformatdisplayattribute.html)

StructuredFormatDisplayAttribute 
This attribute is used to mark how a type is displayed by default when using 
 '%A' printf formatting patterns and other two-dimensional text-based display layouts. 
 In this version of F# valid values are of the form <code>PreText {PropertyName1} PostText {PropertyName2} ... {PropertyNameX} PostText</code>.
 The property names indicate properties to evaluate and to display instead of the object itself.  
StructuredFormatDisplayAttribute.``.ctor`` 
``.ctor`` 
StructuredFormatDisplayAttribute.Value 
Value

StructuredFormatDisplayAttribute.Value 
Value

 using '%A' printf formatting patterns and other two-dimensional text-based display 
 layouts.</pre>

### [UnverifiableAttribute](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-unverifiableattribute.html)

UnverifiableAttribute 
This attribute is used to tag values whose use will result in the generation
 of unverifiable code. These values are inevitably marked 'inline' to ensure that
 the unverifiable constructs are not present in the actual code for the F# library,
 but are rather copied to the source code of the caller.

ValueOption<'T>.op_Implicit 
op_Implicit 
Implicitly converts a value into an optional that is a 'ValueSome' value. 
The F# compiler ignored this method when determining possible type-directed conversions. Instead, use <code>Some</code> or <code>None</code> explicitly.

 values.

 of this type, or the notation <code>arr.[x]</code> to get/set array
 values.

 values.

### [byref<'T>](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-byref-1.html)

byref<'T> 
Represents a managed pointer in F# code. For F# 4.5+ this is considered equivalent to <code>byref<'T, ByRefKinds.InOut></code>

### [byte<'Measure>](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-byte-1.html)

byte<'Measure> 
The type of 8-bit unsigned integer numbers, annotated with a unit of measure. 
 The unit of measure is erased in compiled code and when values of this type
 are analyzed using reflection. The type is representationally equivalent to 
 <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.byte">Byte</a>.

### [byte](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-byte.html)

byte 
An abbreviation for the CLI type <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.byte">Byte</a>.

### [ilsigptr<'T>](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-ilsigptr-1.html)

ilsigptr<'T> 
Represents an Common IL (Intermediate Language) Signature Pointer. 
This type should only be used when writing F# code that interoperates
 with other .NET languages that use generic Common IL Signature Pointers.
 Use of this type in F# code may result in unverifiable code being generated.
 Because of the rules of Common IL Signature Pointers, you cannot use this type in generic type parameters,
 resulting in compiler errors. As a result, you should convert this type to <a href="https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-nativeptr{t}">nativeptr{T}</a>
 for use in F#. Note that Common IL Signature Pointers exposed by other .NET languages are converted to
 <a href="https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-nativeptr{t}">nativeptr{T}</a> or <a href="https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-voidptr.html">voidptr</a> automatically by F#,
 and F# also shows generic-specialized typed native pointers correctly to other .NET languages as Common IL Signature Pointers.
 However, generic typed native pointers are shown as <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.intptr">IntPtr</a> to other .NET languages.
 For other languages to interpret generic F# typed native pointers correctly, you should expose this type or
 <a href="https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-voidptr.html">voidptr</a> instead of <a href="https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-nativeptr{t}">nativeptr{T}</a>.
 Values of this type can be generated by the functions in the <code>NativeInterop.NativePtr</code> module.

### [inref<'T>](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-inref-1.html)

inref<'T> 
Represents a in-argument or readonly managed pointer in F# code. This type should only be used with F# 4.5+.

nativeptr<'T> 
Represents an unmanaged pointer in F# code. 
This type should only be used when writing F# code that interoperates
 with native code. Use of this type in F# code may result in
 unverifiable code being generated. Conversions to and from the 
 <a href="https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-nativeint.html">nativeint</a> type may be required. Values of this type can be generated
 by the functions in the <code>NativeInterop.NativePtr</code> module.

### ['T option](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-option-1.html)

'T option 
The type of optional values. When used from other CLI languages the
 empty option is the <code>null</code> value.  
Use the constructors <code>Some</code> and <code>None</code> to create values of this type.
 Use the values in the <code>Option</code> module to manipulate values of this type,
 or pattern match against the values directly.

 'None' values will appear as the value <code>null</code> to other CLI languages.
 Instance methods on this type will appear as static methods to other CLI languages
 due to the use of <code>null</code> as a value representation. 
'T option.Value 
Value 
'T option.IsSome 
IsSome 
'T option.IsNone 
IsNone 
'T option.None 
None

### ['T option.Value](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-option-1.html#Value)

'T option.Value 
Value 
Get the value of a 'Some' option. A NullReferenceException is raised if the option is 'None'.

### ['T option.IsSome](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-option-1.html#IsSome)

'T option.IsSome 
IsSome 
Return 'true' if the option is a 'Some' value.

### ['T option.IsNone](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-option-1.html#IsNone)

'T option.IsNone 
IsNone 
Return 'true' if the option is a 'None' value.

### ['T option.None](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-option-1.html#None)

'T option.None 
None 
Create an option value that is a 'None' value.

### [StateMachineHelpers](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-compilerservices-statemachinehelpers.html)

StateMachineHelpers

StateMachineHelpers.__debugPoint 
__debugPoint

__useResumableCode

__resumableEntry 
StateMachineHelpers.__resumeAt 
__resumeAt 
StateMachineHelpers.__stateMachine 
__stateMachine

### [StateMachineHelpers.__debugPoint](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-compilerservices-statemachinehelpers.html#__debugPoint)

StateMachineHelpers.__debugPoint 
__debugPoint 

 Indicates a named debug point arising from the context of inlined code.
  

 Only a limited range of debug point names are supported.

 If the debug point name is the empty string then the range used for the debug point will be
 the range of the outermost expression prior to inlining.

 If the debug point name is <code>ForLoop.InOrToKeyword</code> and the code was ultimately
 from a <code>for .. in .. do</code> or <code>for .. = .. to .. do</code> construct in a computation expression,
 de-sugared to an inlined <code>builder.For</code> call, then the name "ForLoop.InOrToKeyword" can be used.
 The range of the debug point will be precisely the range of the <code>in</code> or <code>to</code> keyword.

 If the name doesn't correspond to a known debug point arising from the original source context, then
 an opt-in warning 3514 is emitted, and the range used for the debug point will be
 the range of the root expression prior to inlining.

### [StateMachineHelpers.__useResumableCode](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-compilerservices-statemachinehelpers.html#__useResumableCode)

StateMachineHelpers.__useResumableCode 
__useResumableCode 
 When used in a conditional, statically determines whether the 'then' branch
 represents valid resumable code and provides an alternative implementation
 if not.

### [StateMachineHelpers.__resumableEntry](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-compilerservices-statemachinehelpers.html#__resumableEntry)

StateMachineHelpers.__resumableEntry 
__resumableEntry 
 Indicates a resumption point within resumable code

### [StateMachineHelpers.__resumeAt](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-compilerservices-statemachinehelpers.html#__resumeAt)

StateMachineHelpers.__resumeAt 
__resumeAt 

 Indicates to jump to a resumption point within resumable code.
 This may be the first statement in a MoveNextMethodImpl.
 The integer must be a valid resumption point within this resumable code.

### [StateMachineHelpers.__stateMachine](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-compilerservices-statemachinehelpers.html#__stateMachine)

StateMachineHelpers.__stateMachine 
__stateMachine 

 Statically generates a closure struct type based on ResumableStateMachine,
 At runtime an instance of the new struct type is populated and 'afterMethod' is called
 to consume it.
  

 At compile-time, the ResumableStateMachine type guides the generation of a new struct type by the F# compiler
 with closure-capture fields in a way similar to an object expression. 
 Any mention of the ResumableStateMachine type in any the 'methods' is rewritten to this
 fresh struct type.  The 'methods' are used to implement the interfaces on ResumableStateMachine and are also rewritten.
 The 'after' method is then executed and must eliminate the ResumableStateMachine. For example,
 its return type must not include ResumableStateMachine.

### [NoEagerConstraintApplicationAttribute](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-compilerservices-noeagerconstraintapplicationattribute.html)

NoEagerConstraintApplicationAttribute 
Adding this attribute to the method adjusts the processing of some generic methods
 during overload resolution. 
During overload resolution, caller arguments are matched with called arguments
 to extract type information. By default, when the caller argument type is unconstrained (for example
 a simple value <code>x</code> without known type information), and a method qualifies for
 lambda constraint propagation, then member trait constraints from a method overload
 are eagerly applied to the caller argument type. This causes that overload to be preferred,
 regardless of other method overload resolution rules. Using this attribute suppresses this behaviour. 
  
NoEagerConstraintApplicationAttribute.``.ctor`` 
``.ctor``

### [NoEagerConstraintApplicationAttribute.``.ctor``](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-compilerservices-noeagerconstraintapplicationattribute.html#``.ctor``)

NoEagerConstraintApplicationAttribute.``.ctor`` 
``.ctor`` 
Creates an instance of the attribute

### [TypeProviderConfig](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-compilerservices-typeproviderconfig.html)

TypeProviderConfig 
 If the class that implements ITypeProvider has a constructor that accepts TypeProviderConfig
 then it will be constructed with an instance of TypeProviderConfig.

TypeProviderConfig.ResolutionFolder 
ResolutionFolder 
 Get the full path to use to resolve relative paths in any file name arguments given to the type provider instance.

### [TypeProviderConfig.IsHostedExecution](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-core-compilerservices-typeproviderconfig.html#IsHostedExecution)

TypeProviderConfig.IsHostedExecution 
IsHostedExecution 
 Indicates if the type provider instance is used in an environment which executes provided code such as F# Interactive.

TypeProviderConfig.IsInvalidationSupported 
IsInvalidationSupported 
 Indicates if the type provider host responds to invalidation events for type provider instances.

### [Nullable.byte](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-nullablemodule.html#byte)

Nullable.byte 
byte 
Converts the argument to byte. This is a direct conversion for all 
 primitive numeric types. The operation requires an appropriate
 static conversion method on the input type.

### [Nullable.uint8](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-nullablemodule.html#uint8)

Nullable.uint8 
uint8 
Converts the argument to byte. This is a direct conversion for all 
 primitive numeric types. The operation requires an appropriate
 static conversion method on the input type.

Nullable.sbyte 
sbyte 
Converts the argument to signed byte. This is a direct conversion for all 
 primitive numeric types. The operation requires an appropriate
 static conversion method on the input type.

### [Nullable.int8](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-nullablemodule.html#int8)

int8

 static conversion method on the input type.

 primitive numeric types. The operation requires an appropriate
 static conversion method on the input type.

### [Nullable.char](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-nullablemodule.html#char)

Nullable.char 
char 
Converts the argument to character. Numeric inputs are converted according to the UTF-16 
 encoding for characters. The operation requires an appropriate static conversion method on the input type.

### [NullableOperators.(?>=)](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-nullableoperators.html#(?>=))

This operator is primarily for use in F# queries

### [QueryBuilder](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html)

QueryBuilder 
 The type used to support the F# query syntax. Use 'query { ... }' to use the query syntax. See
 also <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/fsharp/language-reference/query-expressions">F# Query Expressions</a> in the F# Language Guide.

### [QueryBuilder.``.ctor``](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#``.ctor``)

QueryBuilder.``.ctor`` 
``.ctor`` 
Create an instance of this builder. Use 'query { ... }' to use the query syntax.

### [QueryBuilder.All](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#All)

QueryBuilder.All 
All 
A query operator that determines whether all elements selected so far satisfies a condition.

### [QueryBuilder.AverageBy](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#AverageBy)

QueryBuilder.AverageBy 
AverageBy 
A query operator that selects a value for each element selected so far and returns the average of these values.

### [QueryBuilder.AverageByNullable](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#AverageByNullable)

QueryBuilder.AverageByNullable 
AverageByNullable 
A query operator that selects a nullable value for each element selected so far and returns the average of these values. 
 If any nullable does not have a value, it is ignored.

### [QueryBuilder.Contains](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Contains)

QueryBuilder.Contains 
Contains 
A query operator that determines whether the selected elements contains a specified element.

### [QueryBuilder.Count](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Count)

QueryBuilder.Count 
Count 
A query operator that returns the number of selected elements.

### [QueryBuilder.Distinct](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Distinct)

QueryBuilder.Distinct 
Distinct 
A query operator that selects distinct elements from the elements selected so far.

### [QueryBuilder.ExactlyOne](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#ExactlyOne)

QueryBuilder.ExactlyOne 
ExactlyOne 
A query operator that selects the single, specific element selected so far

### [QueryBuilder.ExactlyOneOrDefault](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#ExactlyOneOrDefault)

QueryBuilder.ExactlyOneOrDefault 
ExactlyOneOrDefault 
A query operator that selects the single, specific element of those selected so far, or a default value if that element is not found.

### [QueryBuilder.Exists](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Exists)

QueryBuilder.Exists 
Exists 
A query operator that determines whether any element selected so far satisfies a condition.

### [QueryBuilder.Find](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Find)

QueryBuilder.Find 
Find 
A query operator that selects the first element selected so far that satisfies a specified condition.

### [QueryBuilder.For](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#For)

QueryBuilder.For 
For 

 A method used to support the F# query syntax.  Projects each element of a sequence to another sequence and combines the resulting sequences into one sequence.

### [QueryBuilder.GroupBy](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#GroupBy)

QueryBuilder.GroupBy 
GroupBy 
A query operator that groups the elements selected so far according to a specified key selector.

### [QueryBuilder.GroupJoin](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#GroupJoin)

QueryBuilder.GroupJoin 
GroupJoin 
A query operator that correlates two sets of selected values based on matching keys and groups the results. 
 Normal usage is 'groupJoin y in elements2 on (key1 = key2) into group'.

### [QueryBuilder.GroupValBy](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#GroupValBy)

QueryBuilder.GroupValBy 
GroupValBy 
A query operator that selects a value for each element selected so far and groups the elements by the given key.

### [QueryBuilder.Head](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Head)

QueryBuilder.Head 
Head 
A query operator that selects the first element from those selected so far.

### [QueryBuilder.HeadOrDefault](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#HeadOrDefault)

QueryBuilder.HeadOrDefault 
HeadOrDefault 
A query operator that selects the first element of those selected so far, or a default value if the sequence contains no elements.

### [QueryBuilder.Join](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Join)

QueryBuilder.Join 
Join 
A query operator that correlates two sets of selected values based on matching keys. 
 Normal usage is 'join y in elements2 on (key1 = key2)'.

### [QueryBuilder.Last](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Last)

QueryBuilder.Last 
Last 
A query operator that selects the last element of those selected so far.

### [QueryBuilder.LastOrDefault](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#LastOrDefault)

QueryBuilder.LastOrDefault 
LastOrDefault 
A query operator that selects the last element of those selected so far, or a default value if no element is found.

### [QueryBuilder.LeftOuterJoin](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#LeftOuterJoin)

QueryBuilder.LeftOuterJoin 
LeftOuterJoin 
A query operator that correlates two sets of selected values based on matching keys and groups the results.
 If any group is empty, a group with a single default value is used instead. 
 Normal usage is 'leftOuterJoin y in elements2 on (key1 = key2) into group'.

### [QueryBuilder.MaxBy](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#MaxBy)

QueryBuilder.MaxBy 
MaxBy 
A query operator that selects a value for each element selected so far and returns the maximum resulting value.

### [QueryBuilder.MaxByNullable](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#MaxByNullable)

QueryBuilder.MaxByNullable 
MaxByNullable 
A query operator that selects a nullable value for each element selected so far and returns the maximum of these values. 
 If any nullable does not have a value, it is ignored.

### [QueryBuilder.MinBy](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#MinBy)

QueryBuilder.MinBy 
MinBy 
A query operator that selects a value for each element selected so far and returns the minimum resulting value.

### [QueryBuilder.MinByNullable](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#MinByNullable)

QueryBuilder.MinByNullable 
MinByNullable 
A query operator that selects a nullable value for each element selected so far and returns the minimum of these values. 
 If any nullable does not have a value, it is ignored.

### [QueryBuilder.Nth](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Nth)

QueryBuilder.Nth 
Nth 
A query operator that selects the element at a specified index amongst those selected so far.

### [QueryBuilder.Quote](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Quote)

QueryBuilder.Quote 
Quote 

 A method used to support the F# query syntax.  Indicates that the query should be passed as a quotation to the Run method.

### [QueryBuilder.Run](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Run)

QueryBuilder.Run 
Run 

 A method used to support the F# query syntax.  Runs the given quotation as a query using LINQ IQueryable rules.

### [QueryBuilder.Select](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Select)

QueryBuilder.Select 
Select 
A query operator that projects each of the elements selected so far.

### [QueryBuilder.Skip](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Skip)

QueryBuilder.Skip 
Skip 
A query operator that bypasses a specified number of the elements selected so far and selects the remaining elements.

### [QueryBuilder.SkipWhile](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#SkipWhile)

QueryBuilder.SkipWhile 
SkipWhile 
A query operator that bypasses elements in a sequence as long as a specified condition is true and then selects the remaining elements.

### [QueryBuilder.SortBy](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#SortBy)

QueryBuilder.SortBy 
SortBy 
A query operator that sorts the elements selected so far in ascending order by the given sorting key.

### [QueryBuilder.SortByDescending](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#SortByDescending)

QueryBuilder.SortByDescending 
SortByDescending 
A query operator that sorts the elements selected so far in descending order by the given sorting key.

### [QueryBuilder.SortByNullable](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#SortByNullable)

QueryBuilder.SortByNullable 
SortByNullable 
A query operator that sorts the elements selected so far in ascending order by the given nullable sorting key.

### [QueryBuilder.SortByNullableDescending](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#SortByNullableDescending)

QueryBuilder.SortByNullableDescending 
SortByNullableDescending 
A query operator that sorts the elements selected so far in descending order by the given nullable sorting key.

### [QueryBuilder.Source](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Source)

QueryBuilder.Source 
Source 

 A method used to support the F# query syntax.  Inputs to queries are implicitly wrapped by a call to one of the overloads of this method.

### [QueryBuilder.Source](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Source)

### [QueryBuilder.Take](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Take)

QueryBuilder.Take

### [QueryBuilder.TakeWhile](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#TakeWhile)

QueryBuilder.TakeWhile 
TakeWhile 
A query operator that selects elements from a sequence as long as a specified condition is true, and then skips the remaining elements.

### [QueryBuilder.ThenBy](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#ThenBy)

QueryBuilder.ThenBy 
ThenBy 
A query operator that performs a subsequent ordering of the elements selected so far in ascending order by the given sorting key.
 This operator may only be used immediately after a 'sortBy', 'sortByDescending', 'thenBy' or 'thenByDescending', or their nullable variants.

### [QueryBuilder.ThenByDescending](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#ThenByDescending)

QueryBuilder.ThenByDescending 
ThenByDescending 
A query operator that performs a subsequent ordering of the elements selected so far in descending order by the given sorting key.
 This operator may only be used immediately after a 'sortBy', 'sortByDescending', 'thenBy' or 'thenByDescending', or their nullable variants.

### [QueryBuilder.ThenByNullable](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#ThenByNullable)

QueryBuilder.ThenByNullable 
ThenByNullable 
A query operator that performs a subsequent ordering of the elements selected so far in ascending order by the given nullable sorting key.
 This operator may only be used immediately after a 'sortBy', 'sortByDescending', 'thenBy' or 'thenByDescending', or their nullable variants.

### [QueryBuilder.ThenByNullableDescending](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#ThenByNullableDescending)

QueryBuilder.ThenByNullableDescending 
ThenByNullableDescending 
A query operator that performs a subsequent ordering of the elements selected so far in descending order by the given nullable sorting key.
 This operator may only be used immediately after a 'sortBy', 'sortByDescending', 'thenBy' or 'thenByDescending', or their nullable variants.

### [QueryBuilder.Where](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-querybuilder.html#Where)

QueryBuilder.Where 
Where

### [LeafExpressionConverter.ImplicitExpressionConversionHelper](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-runtimehelpers-leafexpressionconverter.html#ImplicitExpressionConversionHelper)

LeafExpressionConverter.ImplicitExpressionConversionHelper 
ImplicitExpressionConversionHelper 
 When used in a quotation, this function indicates a specific conversion
 should be performed when converting the quotation to a LINQ expression.

 This function should not be called directly.

### [LeafExpressionConverter.MemberInitializationHelper](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-runtimehelpers-leafexpressionconverter.html#MemberInitializationHelper)

LeafExpressionConverter.MemberInitializationHelper 
MemberInitializationHelper 
 When used in a quotation, this function indicates a specific conversion
 should be performed when converting the quotation to a LINQ expression.

 This function should not be called directly.

LeafExpressionConverter.NewAnonymousObjectHelper 
NewAnonymousObjectHelper 
 When used in a quotation, this function indicates a specific conversion
 should be performed when converting the quotation to a LINQ expression.

 This function should not be called directly.

### [LeafExpressionConverter.QuotationToExpression](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-runtimehelpers-leafexpressionconverter.html#QuotationToExpression)

LeafExpressionConverter.QuotationToExpression 
QuotationToExpression 

 Converts a subset of F# quotations to a LINQ expression, for the subset of LINQ expressions represented by the
 expression syntax in the C# language.

### [LeafExpressionConverter.QuotationToLambdaExpression](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-runtimehelpers-leafexpressionconverter.html#QuotationToLambdaExpression)

LeafExpressionConverter.QuotationToLambdaExpression 
QuotationToLambdaExpression 

 Converts a subset of F# quotations to a LINQ expression, for the subset of LINQ expressions represented by the
 expression syntax in the C# language.

### [LeafExpressionConverter.EvaluateQuotation](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-linq-runtimehelpers-leafexpressionconverter.html#EvaluateQuotation)

LeafExpressionConverter.EvaluateQuotation 
EvaluateQuotation 

 Evaluates a subset of F# quotations by first converting to a LINQ expression, for the subset of LINQ expressions represented by the
 expression syntax in the C# language.

Returns a typed native pointer for a given machine address.

### [NativePtr.add](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-nativeinterop-nativeptrmodule.html#add)

NativePtr.add 
add 
Returns a typed native pointer by adding index * sizeof<'T> to the
 given input pointer.

### [NativePtr.get](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-nativeinterop-nativeptrmodule.html#get)

NativePtr.get 
get 
Dereferences the typed native pointer computed by adding index * sizeof<'T> to the
 given input pointer.

### [NativePtr.read](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-nativeinterop-nativeptrmodule.html#read)

NativePtr.read 
read 
Dereferences the given typed native pointer.

### [NativePtr.write](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-nativeinterop-nativeptrmodule.html#write)

NativePtr.write 
write 
Assigns the <code>value</code> into the memory location referenced by the given typed native pointer.

### [NativePtr.set](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-nativeinterop-nativeptrmodule.html#set)

NativePtr.set 
set 
Assigns the <code>value</code> into the memory location referenced by the typed native
 pointer computed by adding index * sizeof<'T> to the given input pointer.

Allocates a region of memory on the stack.

### [NativePtr.initBlock](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-nativeinterop-nativeptrmodule.html#initBlock)

NativePtr.initBlock 
initBlock 
Initializes a specified block of memory starting at a specific address to a given byte count and initial byte value.

### [NativePtr.copy](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-nativeinterop-nativeptrmodule.html#copy)

NativePtr.copy 
copy 
Copies a value to a specified destination address from a specified source address.

### [NativePtr.copyBlock](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-nativeinterop-nativeptrmodule.html#copyBlock)

NativePtr.copyBlock 
copyBlock 
Copies a block of memory to a specified destination address starting from a specified source address until a specified byte count of (count * sizeof<'T>).

DerivedPatterns.(|SpecificCall|_|) 
(|SpecificCall|_|) 
A parameterized active pattern to recognize calls to a specified function or method.
 The returned elements are the optional target object (present if the target is an
 instance method), the generic type instantiation (non-empty if the target is a generic
 instantiation), and the arguments to the function or method.

Expr.Substitute 
Substitute 
Substitutes through the given expression using the given functions
 to map variables to new values. The functions must give consistent results
 at each application. Variable renaming may occur on the target expression
 if variable capture occurs.

### [FSharpReflectionExtensions.GetRecordFields](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpreflectionextensions.html#GetRecordFields)

FSharpReflectionExtensions.GetRecordFields 
GetRecordFields 
Reads all the fields from a record value. 
Assumes the given input is a record value. If not, <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception">ArgumentException</a> is raised.

### [FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeRecordReader](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpreflectionextensions.html#PreComputeRecordReader)

FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeRecordReader 
PreComputeRecordReader 
Precompute a function for reading all the fields from a record. The fields are returned in the
 same order as the fields reported by a call to Microsoft.FSharp.Reflection.Type.GetInfo for
 this type. 
Assumes the given type is a RecordType.
 If not, <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception">ArgumentException</a> is raised during pre-computation.

 Using the computed function will typically be faster than executing a corresponding call to Value.GetInfo
 because the path executed by the computed function is optimized given the knowledge that it will be
 used to read values of the given type.

### [FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeRecordConstructor](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpreflectionextensions.html#PreComputeRecordConstructor)

FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeRecordConstructor 
PreComputeRecordConstructor 
Precompute a function for constructing a record value.  
Assumes the given type is a RecordType.
 If not, <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception">ArgumentException</a> is raised during pre-computation.

### [FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeRecordConstructorInfo](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpreflectionextensions.html#PreComputeRecordConstructorInfo)

FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeRecordConstructorInfo 
PreComputeRecordConstructorInfo

MakeUnion

### [FSharpReflectionExtensions.GetUnionFields](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpreflectionextensions.html#GetUnionFields)

FSharpReflectionExtensions.GetUnionFields 
GetUnionFields 
Identify the union case and its fields for an object 
Assumes the given input is a union case value. If not, <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception">ArgumentException</a> is raised.

 If the type is not given, then the runtime type of the input object is used to identify the
 relevant union type. The type should always be given if the input object may be null. For example,
 option values may be represented using the 'null'.

### [FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeUnionTagReader](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpreflectionextensions.html#PreComputeUnionTagReader)

FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeUnionTagReader 
PreComputeUnionTagReader 
Assumes the given type is a union type.
 If not, <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception">ArgumentException</a> is raised during pre-computation. 
Using the computed function is more efficient than calling GetUnionCase
 because the path executed by the computed function is optimized given the knowledge that it will be
 used to read values of the given type.

### [FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeUnionTagMemberInfo](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpreflectionextensions.html#PreComputeUnionTagMemberInfo)

FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeUnionTagMemberInfo 
PreComputeUnionTagMemberInfo 
Precompute a property or static method for reading an integer representing the case tag of a union type.

### [FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeUnionReader](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpreflectionextensions.html#PreComputeUnionReader)

FSharpReflectionExtensions.PreComputeUnionReader 
PreComputeUnionReader 
Precompute a function for reading all the fields for a particular discriminator case of a union type 
Using the computed function will typically be faster than executing a corresponding call to GetFields

PreComputeUnionConstructor

GetExceptionFields

### [FSharpReflectionExtensions.GetUnionCases](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpreflectionextensions.html#GetUnionCases)

FSharpReflectionExtensions.GetUnionCases

### [FSharpValue.GetUnionFields](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpvalue.html#GetUnionFields)

FSharpValue.GetUnionFields 
GetUnionFields 
Identify the union case and its fields for an object 
Assumes the given input is a union case value. If not, <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception">ArgumentException</a> is raised.

 If the type is not given, then the runtime type of the input object is used to identify the
 relevant union type. The type should always be given if the input object may be null. For example,
 option values may be represented using the 'null'.

### [FSharpValue.PreComputeRecordFieldReader](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpvalue.html#PreComputeRecordFieldReader)

FSharpValue.PreComputeRecordFieldReader 
PreComputeRecordFieldReader 
Precompute a function for reading a particular field from a record.
 Assumes the given type is a RecordType with a field of the given name.
 If not, <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception">ArgumentException</a> is raised during pre-computation. 
Using the computed function will typically be faster than executing a corresponding call to Value.GetInfo
 because the path executed by the computed function is optimized given the knowledge that it will be
 used to read values of the given type.

### [FSharpValue.PreComputeRecordReader](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpvalue.html#PreComputeRecordReader)

FSharpValue.PreComputeRecordReader 
PreComputeRecordReader 
Precompute a function for reading all the fields from a record. The fields are returned in the
 same order as the fields reported by a call to Microsoft.FSharp.Reflection.Type.GetInfo for
 this type. 
Assumes the given type is a RecordType.
 If not, <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception">ArgumentException</a> is raised during pre-computation.

 Using the computed function will typically be faster than executing a corresponding call to Value.GetInfo
 because the path executed by the computed function is optimized given the knowledge that it will be
 used to read values of the given type.

### [FSharpValue.PreComputeTupleConstructor](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpvalue.html#PreComputeTupleConstructor)

FSharpValue.PreComputeTupleConstructor 
PreComputeTupleConstructor 
Precompute a function for reading the values of a particular tuple type 
Assumes the given type is a TupleType.
 If not, <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception">ArgumentException</a> is raised during pre-computation.

### [FSharpValue.PreComputeTupleConstructorInfo](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpvalue.html#PreComputeTupleConstructorInfo)

FSharpValue.PreComputeTupleConstructorInfo 
PreComputeTupleConstructorInfo 
Gets a method that constructs objects of the given tuple type.
 For small tuples, no additional type will be returned. 
For large tuples, an additional type is returned indicating that
 a nested encoding has been used for the tuple type. In this case
 the suffix portion of the tuple type has the given type and an
 object of this type must be created and passed as the last argument
 to the ConstructorInfo. A recursive call to PreComputeTupleConstructorInfo
 can be used to determine the constructor for that the suffix type.

### [FSharpValue.PreComputeTuplePropertyInfo](https://fsharp.github.io/fsharp-core-docs/reference/fsharp-reflection-fsharpvalue.html#PreComputeTuplePropertyInfo)

Gets information that indicates how to read a field of a tuple

Assumes the given type is a union type.
 If not, <a href="https://learn.microsoft.com/dotnet/api/system.argumentexception">ArgumentException</a> is raised during pre-computation. 
Using the computed function is more efficient than calling GetUnionCase
 because the path executed by the computed function is optimized given the knowledge that it will be
 used to read values of the given type.
